title: Pointer to the properties of [def-kun-separably-closed]
text:
In the notation of [def-kun-separably-closed], the following holds. The two facts about finite extensions
of a separably closed field used below are
[lem-kun-sep-closed-finite-extension-purely-inseparable] (purity of
inseparability) and
[lem-kun-sep-closed-finite-extension-sep-closed] (inheritance of
separable closedness).
